kicker: Q2 FY27 results by company size · 2,891 companies
title: The bigger the company, the better the quarter.
dek: Half of micro-caps grew profit this season, against 74% of companies above ₹1 lakh crore, and large caps were the only group where most stocks beat the index on results day.

read: This season rewarded scale: larger companies grew profit more reliably and were rewarded for it, while the long tail of micro-caps lagged on both.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE (consolidated where available), as of 18 Nov 2026; day-one reaction vs the benchmark index
notes: Market cap at the time results were filed; banks excluded. Micro-caps are many and volatile, so their median hides a wide spread. Results-day reaction = stock move on the first trading day after results minus the index move.
